scope: read-only diagnosis of existing learning-rate checkpoints on their selected training examples; no new training
inputs: completed training-lr run, its exact selection.npz, initial_state.pt and both last_checkpoint.pt; verify against report hashes
measurements: activation RMS and exact zero fraction at every feature layer
SE gate distribution and fraction below 0.05 or above 0.95
per-channel temporal means and population variances
leave-one-out nearest class centroid on fixed descriptors
confusion matrix from actual saved model
descriptor: For temporal tensors concatenate channel means and population variances; vector tensors unchanged. No fitted scaling or representation selection.
centroid_rule: Euclidean distance to class means, excluding the queried sample from its own class mean; descriptive training diagnostic only
controls: same selected examples and labels, eval mode, no gradients or weight updates, no validation/test access, deterministic batch size 8
interpretation: Moment descriptors discard time structure; poor descriptor separation does not establish information loss in full activations. Correlated layer changes do not prove a causal bottleneck. SE gate size alone does not prove gradient failure. No layer chosen by accuracy for deployment.
decision: First inspect exact checkpoint prediction reproduction; then identify candidate stages for a separately planned intervention. Do not change the model or launch more training based solely on descriptor scores.
